[Section] Experiments ::: Named Entity Recognition ::: Baselines
[source_id=62] We use the following baselines:
[source_id=63] ELMo: a tagging model from peters2018deep.
[source_id=64] Lattice-LSTM: lattice2018zhang constructs a word-character lattice, only used in Chinese datasets.
[source_id=65] CVT: from kevin2018cross, which uses Cross-View Training(CVT) to improve the representations of a Bi-LSTM encoder.
[source_id=66] Bert-Tagger: devlin2018bert treats NER as a tagging task.
[source_id=67] Glyce-BERT: wu2019glyce combines glyph information with BERT pretraining.
[source_id=68] BERT-MRC: The current SOTA model for both Chinese and English NER datasets proposed by xiaoya2019ner, which formulate NER as machine reading comprehension task.
